note: Import sandiego.png. Horizontal axes of the source capture are Web Mercator metres; every figure here is already converted to true ground metres by cos(lat). The playable area is the capture, centred; the ring outside it is generated out-of-bounds terrain.

water.note: The capture has no bathymetry. Water bodies are dug from their own surface level; tidal ones are levelled on datum so the ocean actor at Z=0 is the waterline. Run this after maps3d-roadmesh.mjs.
